lines.text: 根因矩阵：同一症状可能有四类来源
lines.zh: 根因矩阵：同一症状可能有四类来源
lines.en: Root-cause matrix: one symptom can have four sources

lines.text: 权衡判断：同一Arc签名可有多个根因；多个边缘条件也可能叠加放大
lines.zh: 权衡判断：同一Arc签名可有多个根因；多个边缘条件也可能叠加放大
lines.en: Trade-off: one arc signature can have several root causes; multiple marginal conditions can combine and amplify

lines.text: 下游决策：清洁、换件、Ground修复、
lines.zh: 下游决策：清洁、换件、Ground修复、
lines.en: Downstream decisions: cleaning, part replacement, ground repair,

lines.text: 边界注记：根因优先级随PVD、Etch、PECVD与设备结构化，
lines.zh: 边界注记：根因优先级随PVD、Etch、PECVD与设备结构变化。
lines.en: Boundary: root-cause priorities vary with PVD, etch, PECVD and equipment architecture.
